title: Classified F-117 crash near Bakersfield

tellings.quote: And that that crashed in Bakersfield in 1986 or something

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, mentions in passing that a secret F-117, the US military's stealth attack jet, crashed near Bakersfield, California, in 1986 "or something," as he puts it. He brings it up as an example of classified aircraft that the public didn't know about at the time, which matters to the wider question of what strange things in the sky might really be.
